company.shortDescription: Collar provides an all-in-one collaboration platform for professionals and their clients.
company.description:
Collar is a software platform which aims to help professionals deliver better, more holistic advice to their clients.

The platform provides a secure place for professionals and their clients to easily track tasks, communicate and share files. Most importantly, Collar empowers professionals to collaborate directly with professionals from different organizations regarding a shared client. Collar was founded in 2017 and is based in New Jersey.
